reproduction_target: MrHAMER2 snakemake bioinformatic pipeline + APHIX viral-isoform analysis: computational processing of dual-UMI nanopore long-read RNA-seq (ENA PRJEB88729) into HIV-1 isoform quantification, splice-junction usage, and isoform productivity.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods prose. Two workflow repos named (MrHAMER2, APHIX) but not read at line level (stage-1 prose-only). Wet-lab procedures counted in W, not verdicted (layer W / OOS for computational reproduction).

steps.label: MrHAMER2 snakemake pipeline (read clustering, dual-UMI consensus, high-accuracy read generation) — min_reads_per_cluster=2/4, balance_strands=True
APHIX pipeline (Analysis Pipeline for HIV Isoform eXploration) — isoform/splice-junction quantification, cluster_size=2
Dual-UMI duplex basecalling with guppy_basecaller_duplex (version 6.1.7), full CLI args given (--duplex_pairing_mode from_pair_list, pairs.txt)
Isoform productivity / ORF analysis using 'ORF Finder' in Geneious with per-gene length filters (Env/Nef/Rev/Tat/Vpr/Vif), validated against UniProt
